title: A Peregrine Falcon Dives at 200 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: A peregrine falcon dives at 200 miles an hour.
Guinness lists it as the fastest bird in a dive.
In 1999, a falconer strapped altimeters to a falcon named Frightful.
Some of those dives came out near 242 miles an hour.
Some scientists doubted it, since the dives started higher than usual.
Still the fastest dive of any bird. Watch that drop again.

description:
Guinness lists the peregrine falcon's dive at about 200 miles an hour.
In a 1999 experiment, altimeters on a falcon named Frightful suggested dives near 242.
Some scientists doubted those numbers.
What's the fastest you've ever moved?
first_comment: Would you ride on a falcon's back for one dive?
